description: This Java class represents a Splash Screen activity for an Android application. It manages initial UI setup, loads driver data from local storage, and fetches additional vehicle and job data from external APIs to prepare the main app.

classes.name: SplashScreen
classes.description: An Android activity class responsible for displaying a splash screen, initializing app data, and redirecting to login or main activity based on stored user data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the splash screen UI, sets status bar color, reads stored driver data, and sets a timer to transition to login or main activity after 2 seconds.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses JSON response string to extract driver and vehicle information, fetches additional data via API calls, and navigates to MainActivity if data is valid.
